data.title: Finds from the Dolná Mariková – Šimunky (Široká) hillfort
data.excerpt: In 2000 an archaeological field survey led by Jozef Moravčík rescued a large number of metal finds from the hillfort at Dolná Mariková – Šimunky (Široká) before metal detectorists could reach them. We are the first in Slovakia to publish photographs of these finds from the Púchov culture, Great Moravia and the Middle Ages.

children.text: In 2000 an archaeological field survey was carried out at the hillfort in Dolná Mariková, in the locality known as Šimunky – Široká, under the direction of Mgr. Jozef Moravčík; it was aimed above all at rescuing the metal objects lying on the hillfort. Thanks to this intervention a great many unique archaeological finds from the period of the Púchov culture, but chiefly from Great Moravia and the Middle Ages, were saved from metal detectorists.

With the consent of a participant in the survey, who is also the author of the photographs, we are the first in Slovakia to bring you pictures of these remarkable finds, which have not so far been published in the specialist literature.

The photographs of the finds are taken from the set of documents: OLŠOVSKÝ, M. – MELIŠ, Š. – MORAVČÍK, J.: Po stopách predkov. Archeológia stredného Považia od praveku po stredovek (In the Footsteps of Our Ancestors. The Archaeology of the Middle Váh Region from Prehistory to the Middle Ages). A set of documents and photographs. Published by Martin Olšovský at his own expense, 2008, print run of 4 copies.

children.text: Without a specialist description the informative value of the finds is only partial, so we can only hope that they will be published professionally as soon as possible.
